scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Site Recovery 操作场景：创建保管库 → 启用复制 → 列出复制项 → 故障切换 → 删除
commands: az site-recovery vault create --name test-vault --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az site-recovery vault show --name test-vault --resource-group test-rg
az site-recovery replication-item list --vault-name test-vault --resource-group test-rg
az site-recovery vault delete --name test-vault --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：保管库创建成功但复制项列表失败
commands: az site-recovery vault create --name fail-vault --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az site-recovery replication-item list --vault-name fail-vault --resource-group test-rg

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：保管库不存在
commands: az site-recovery vault show --name nonexistent-vault --resource-group test-rg
